A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, Meta-Continual Learning of Neural Fields. All 23 pages, including Appendices A–F, are readable, and the text, equations, tables, and figures support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction and view-synthesis experiments across six datasets, with quantitative comparisons, ablations, computational measurements, and qualitative results in Section 5 and Appendices B–F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and their outcomes, including the main benchmark results and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same MAML-based shared initialization, spatial/temporal modularization, Fisher-information weighting loss, and inference procedure. No method component or architecture changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate CelebA, FFHQ, ImageNette, VoxCeleb2, LibriSpeech, and MatrixCity on the same tasks. The longer task sequences and resolution-reduced scenarios in the appendices are also present in both versions.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments in Tables 1–3 and 6 and Figure 2. The same comparisons involve OL, CL, ER, EWC, MER, MOL/LearnedInit, MAML+CL, and OML where applicable.

E3.justification: The four-task main design, 500K outer-step setting, modality-specific models and preprocessing, MatrixCity 70/30 split, and PSNR/SSIM/PESQ metrics are unchanged. Appendix protocols for longer sequences, reduced resolution, and computational measurements also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the modularization versus MIM comparison, hidden-dimension ablations, five- and ten-task evaluations, resolution-reduced experiments, computational analysis, and reconstruction visualizations in Appendices C–F. No analytical question or supporting evidence is added or removed.

E5.justification: Section 5.1 reports averaging three experimental runs in both versions. Run/seed disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–7, plotted curves, and qualitative reconstructions match. For example, Table 1 retains Ours at 45.40 PSNR on CelebA at step 4096 and Ours (MIM) at 32.804 on MatrixCity-B5 at step 1024.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same three theorems and derivations concerning Fisher information and KL divergence, FIM-SGD convergence, and the generalization bound, including their assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty and contribution claims: introducing MCL-NF, combining modularization with meta-learning, proposing FIM loss with theoretical guarantees, and improving reconstruction quality and learning speed.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitations concerning long dissimilar task sequences, memory growth with task count, and abrupt distribution changes.

D1.justification: Implementation, model, preprocessing, and hardware disclosures remain unchanged, including the PyTorch implementation and TITAN X Pascal details in Appendix E. The abstract only changes the repository-name capitalization from MCL-NF to mcl-nf; it supplies no new resource or access instructions.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to continual neural fields, meta-learning, meta-continual learning, and mixture-of-experts methods. No citation or substantive research-positioning change appears.

P1.justification: The abstract's repository name is lowercased, and the marginal arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The scientific prose, terminology, headings, section order, and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4, Tables 1–7, and Algorithm 1 retain their graphical content, structures, captions, and placement. Inspection confirms unchanged image content, plot geometry, and overall page layout.

improvement.justification: The complete main text and appendices preserve the same methods, empirical evidence, proofs, interpretations, and limitations. The repository-capitalization and version/date edits do not materially improve or diminish scientific support, clarity, or reproducibility.
